tasks.label: Setup: install everything
tasks.command: cd pipeline && python3 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && pip install -e '.[dev]' && cd ../web && npm install

windows.command: cd pipeline; python -m venv .venv; .venv\Scripts\activate; pip install -e '.[dev]'; cd ..\web; npm install

tasks.label: App: demo mode
tasks.command: cd web && NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=demo NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=demo npm run dev

tasks.label: Probe: all sources
tasks.command: cd pipeline && . .venv/bin/activate && mhdebt probe maricopa && mhdebt probe pima && mhdebt probe fdic && mhdebt probe cmbs --limit 3

windows.command: cd pipeline; .venv\Scripts\activate; mhdebt probe maricopa; mhdebt probe pima; mhdebt probe fdic; mhdebt probe cmbs --limit 3

tasks.label: Pipeline: rebuild scores
tasks.command: cd pipeline && . .venv/bin/activate && mhdebt build && mhdebt model && mhdebt top --n 30

windows.command: cd pipeline; .venv\Scripts\activate; mhdebt build; mhdebt model; mhdebt top --n 30
